parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Good morning all of you. I do apologize for being a little late starting our meeting. One of our guests has been taken ill. Susie, who is our assistant manager, has driven him to the hospital. (11) She was in the middle of compiling our weekly report for head office, which is urgent, and I had to finish writing it for her.

Now, this is the first day of work at the Ocean Edge Hotel for all of you. Let me say something that might surprise you—you've all got a qualification in hospitality, and some of you have got very high grades, (12) but to me, what counts most is that you enjoy the contact with guests and really want to make a career in the hospitality industry. You'll be getting some very valuable experience here, so make the most of it.

A few words about the history of the Ocean Edge Hotel. There have been buildings on this site for about 250 years. We know that in the 18th century there was a bakery here when the town was very new. The building was destroyed by fire in the early 19th century, and houses were constructed on the site. (13) These, in their turn, were demolished in the middle of the 20th century and replaced by the hotel.

I think it's fair to say that this is a popular place to work. We're always getting job applications from local people, even when we haven't any vacancies. And whereas in many hotels staff tend to stay for a year or even less, (14) here five years is pretty standard. In fact, several of our staff have been here for ten years or more. You’re the first people we’ve appointed in the last three years. And we only needed to do that because we’re currently constructing 25 new bedrooms.

Depending on their location, hotels usually have mostly business guests or mostly tourists. We attract a large number of tourists who come to spend a few days beside the ocean. We also have quite a lot of people who are here on business and perhaps stay for one or two nights. (15) What we’ve noticed recently though is that we’re getting more and more regulars—people staying here for four nights every week because they have jobs in this locality, but live somewhere else in the country, so they go home for the weekend.

Now let me give you an idea of the layout of the hotel. All the bedrooms are along walkways in the gardens, and the main building, which we're in now, has most of the other rooms that guests use.

Obviously, when they arrive, the first place they find themselves in is the reception area where we're sitting. (16) The desk is over on the right of the entrance, and the office is immediately behind it. There’s a connecting door from the desk itself and another entrance from the corridor. A lot of local residents hire (17) the function room for parties and other events. This is right at the front of the hotel, on the left of the reception area, opposite the desk. This room is booked several evenings a week, and most weekends, it's a major source of income. Companies are very important customers for us, and a large number of local firms hold conferences here. (18) To reach the main conference room, you go past the fountain as far as you can, and the doors are directly in front of you.

(19) The meeting room is often hired by companies and other local organizations for small gatherings. For this room, you turn into the corridor at the side of the reception desk, and you'll see the room facing you at the end of the corridor. Our (20) restaurant is open to the public as well as to hotel residents, and I’m pleased to say it has a very good reputation locally. You turn left just before the fountain, as though you're heading for the guest's rooms, and it’s the large room on your right.

Next, I should mention that there...

questions.question: Why has the manager arrived late at this meeting?

analyses.content: 经理迟到是因为副经理 Susie 送客人去医院了，他不得不帮 Susie 写完那份紧急报告（finish writing it）。
Susie, who is our assistant manager, has driven him to the hospital. She was in the middle of compiling our weekly report for head office, which is urgent, and I had to finish writing it for her.
你可能听到“hospital”就想选 C，但送客人去医院的是 Susie，而不是经理本人。

questions.question: What is the main thing the manager is looking for in his staff?

analyses.content: you've all got a qualification in hospitality, and some of you have got very high grades, but to me, what counts most is that you enjoy the contact with guests and really want to make a career in the hospitality industry.
虽然录音提到了 qualifications（资格证书），但经理紧接着用了转折词 "but to me"，说明证书不是他最看重的。
经理说对他而言最重要的是你享受与客人接触（enjoy the contact），这对应选项 B 的“热情（Enthusiasm）”。

questions.question: When did the Ocean Edge Hotel first open?

analyses.content: These, in their turn, were demolished in the middle of the 20th century and replaced by the hotel.
要分清时间线：18 世纪是面包房，19 世纪是房子，只有 20 世纪才变成酒店。
录音明确提到原有的房屋在 20 世纪中期被拆除，并被这家酒店“取代（replaced）”，说明酒店是在 20 世纪开业的。

questions.question: How long do staff generally remain at the hotel?

analyses.content: And whereas in many hotels staff tend to stay for a year or even less, here five years is pretty standard. In fact, several of our staff have been here for ten years or more.
你可能听到 ten years，但那是针对“几位（several）”老员工的特例，不是普遍现象。
经理说在这家酒店，员工待“五年（five years）”是非常标准的（pretty standard），即普遍情况。

questions.question: Which group of guests is growing fastest?

analyses.content: What we’ve noticed recently though is that we’re getting more and more regulars—people staying here for four nights every week because they have jobs in this locality, but live somewhere else in the country, so they go home for the weekend.
你可能听到 tourists（游客）很多，但题目问的是 "growing fastest"（增长最快），对应录音中的 "more and more"。
录音说最近注意到越来越多（more and more）的回头客是在当地工作但家在外地、周末回家的人。
录音说前台桌子在右边，而办公室就在桌子的“正后方（immediately behind it）”。
The desk is over on the right of the entrance, and the office is immediately behind it.
注意方位介词 behind，不要被后面的 corridor（走廊）干扰，办公室是紧挨着前台桌子的。
This is right at the front of the hotel, on the left of the reception area, opposite the desk.
这题全靠方位词，听到 "left of reception" 和 "opposite desk" 就能精确定位。
录音描述该房间在酒店前部，位于接待区的“左边（left）”，正对着前台桌子（opposite the desk）。
To reach the main conference room, you go past the fountain as far as you can, and the doors are directly in front of you.
关键指令是 "go past the fountain"（经过喷泉）且还要走到头，不要在喷泉附近就停下来。
录音指示你经过喷泉（fountain）一直走到尽头（as far as you can），门就在你正前方。
For this room, you turn into the corridor at the side of the reception desk, and you'll see the room facing you at the end of the corridor.
注意区分 Main Conference Room（大路走到头）和 Meeting Room（拐进小走廊走到头）。
录音说要转进前台桌子旁边的“走廊（corridor）”，房间就在走廊尽头面对着你。
You turn left just before the fountain, as though you're heading for the guest's rooms, and it’s the large room on your right.
一定要听清 "just before the fountain"（在喷泉之前），如果过了喷泉再找就错了。
录音指示在到达喷泉“之前（just before）”向左转，然后它就是你右手边的大房间。
